plain_english: Though proved by a thousand blazing reasons, it succeeds not for the deluded-minded; Maheśvara, placed on the palm, yet flees the fate-struck — the true jewel.
sanskrit_cite: samujjvalannyāyasahasrasādhito'pyupaiti siddhiṃ na vimūḍhacetasām maheśvaraḥ pāṇitalasthito'pi san palāyate daivahatasya sanmaṇiḥ

plain_english: One's own self indeed — this — flashes forth: Īśvara within all breathers, maker and knower too; yet recognition of the beyond is to be effected, and the joining is made by us elsewhere. But Īśvara-proved stands even in duality — fitting, and more: fire shines at midnight.
sanskrit_cite: svātmaivāyaṃ sphurati sakalaprāṇināmīśvaro'ntaḥ kartā jñātāpi ca yadi paraṃ pratyabhijñāsya sādhyā sā cāsmābhirvihitaghaṭanānyatra kiṃ tvīśasiddhirdvaite'pyastītyucitamadhikaṃ bhāti vahnirniśīthe
